content.short: P2Flux provides non-custodial USDC payment infrastructure on Base for one-time payments, automatic subscriptions, and direct merchant-wallet settlement.
content.description: P2Flux is non-custodial USDC payment infrastructure on Base for online merchants and developers. One-time payments and automatic subscription renewals settle directly from customer wallets to merchant wallets, with no P2Flux balance or withdrawal process. Integration is available through a hosted checkout, webhooks, REST API, and JavaScript/TypeScript and PHP SDKs.
